description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: review PR6 diff and plan evidence against its actual restacked parent; no planned production changes in this review issue. Verify source ownership and excluded PR5/PR7 files, contracts/security/lifetimes, Action reuse, native execution traces, test behavior approval evidence and documentation parity. Reproduce correctness findings through focused real-boundary tests; track remediation before closing. Do not post reviews or publish a PR without user authorization.
Tests to add before implementation: review uses existing tests and adds a focused regression only when proving an uncovered defect, following normal approval boundaries. Require fresh targeted validation evidence from affected tasks. Inspect alias scope leakage, forged/nested-principal signature reuse, atomic selection failure, concurrent completion ordering, replays, terminal cleanup and provider acquisition count. No numerical coverage target or premature coverage run.
Branches/paths validated: complete PR6 acceptance matrix, source reference adaptations, error/cancel/timeout/refusal/handoff and next request, no raw handle/content exposure; no duplicate Action or send path. Compare base-versus-branch behavior to distinguish inherited issues.
Mocking plan: real internal ownership/execution paths; use edge stubs for reproducible provider/LLM failures. Findings must cite concrete execution evidence, not speculative abstractions.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: review verdict, findings, scope and fixes in Beadwork; update owning docs through remediation if needed. Final human approval is distinct from technical review.
Action reuse assessment: review-only, no new executable operation; audit ActionContract/Jido validated calls, GetDocument authorization, Provenance projection, OpaqueAliases traversal, StreamEvents state owner, canonical builder and PR5 route. Require successful technical review before handing off to coverage-upper.

Implementation constraints: This is a proposed plan only. The current request authorizes setup and Beadwork planning, not implementation, commits, pushes, rebases or publication. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before later execution; read the owning service guide and each touched module's @moduledoc. Agent work also follows docs/services/agent.md#harness-critical-checks-for-coding-agents. Recheck live source/contracts after PR5 advances. Preserve existing test behavior; if an assertion/scenario must change, record old/proposed behavior and obtain specific human approval first. No such changes are approved here. New unit/integration/property tests are immediate and written before production code. Keep real internal boundaries and isolated fixture/process state; inject runtime dependencies through established opts/context and Zaq.Config.get/4 where relevant, without global configuration mutation. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle in docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; do not treat historical/reference runs as current validation. PR5 owns delivery execution/outcomes; PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
